stories.title: SkyW4lker Phishing Campaign Expands, Threatening US Enterprises with Microsoft 365 Account Takeovers
stories.description: A phishing kit called SkyW4lker (also branded SkyW4lker x365 Sentinel) is quietly taking over Microsoft 365 accounts without ever stealing a password.

stories.title: 6 Challenges SOC Leaders Should Turn into Priorities in 2027
stories.description: Security teams face mounting pressure to keep pace with increasingly complex threats while working within tight budgets and persistent staffing constraints.

stories.title: Critical Ruby on Rails Flaw Could Let Hackers Steal Server Secrets Through Malicious Image Uploads
stories.description: A critical flaw in Ruby on Rails Active Storage lets an unauthenticated user upload a crafted image and make the server write files. If uploads use the Disk service, the same upload can make the server read files too.

stories.title: Debian and Ubuntu APT Flaw Lets MitM Attackers Swap Verified Packages and Run Code as Root
stories.description: APT flaw CVE-2026-109518 lets attackers with HTTP traffic control replace verified packages and execute code as root when downloads retry.

stories.title: SonicWall Won't Patch EoL GMS Flaws That Could Expose Files, Alter Database Records
stories.description: SonicWall warns two flaws in end-of-life GMS 9.5.2 and earlier will remain unpatched, allowing file reads or SQL injection under specific conditions.

stories.title: Debian and Ubuntu APT Flaw Lets Hackers Hijack Software Updates and Execute Code as Root
stories.description: A newly disclosed bug in APT, the package manager behind Debian and Ubuntu, can let a network spy swap a trusted software package for a bad one.

stories.title: Researchers Uncover Prompt Adware Hidden in OpenAI Codex Jailbreak Toolkit
stories.description: Haiou jailbreak modifies OpenAI Codex instructions to inject persistent ads for a third-party LLM gateway into agent responses.

stories.title: Sysdig Adds Runtime Security and Governance for AI Agents
stories.description: Sysdig’s platform uses runtime visibility to track AI agent actions and block risky behavior before it reaches production systems.

stories.title: APT29-Linked Hackers Hijack Web Analytics Script to Deliver iOS and Android Exploits
stories.description: APT29-linked attackers use compromised sites and Plerdy analytics to deliver iOS and Android exploits that steal browser and device data.

stories.title: Barracuda ESG Authentication Bypass Flaw Opens Path to Root
stories.description: An authentication bypass and a command injection flaw can be chained for root access on Barracuda’s Email Security Gateway appliances.

stories.title: Agentic Data Security Firm Sentra Raises $150 Million
stories.description: The company will invest in agentic data security capabilities and expand its go-to-market organization.
